title: Squamish Boat Rentals (Office)
specs: Explore Howe Sound with views of wildlife including salmon, otters, seals, sea lions, porpoises, and orcas
Access to marine trails and boat-access only campsites and viewpoints
Nearby attractions include Shannon Falls, Britannia Beach, Anvil Island, and Porteau Cove
Drivers must be at least 21 years old
Drivers must be proficient in English and have a valid Driver’s License
Boat license required; temporary licenses available for $25 per driver
Boats accommodate 4-5 adults comfortably; max 7 with surcharge
Maximum 2 permitted drivers per rental vessel

blurb: Guests rent various watercraft including 17-foot fiberglass and inflatable boats, Yamaha WaveRunner jetskis, Catalina sailboats, kayaks, canoes, and paddleboards. Rentals include safety equipment and fuel allowances. Guests explore Howe Sound and nearby marine trails, with guidance on local water conditions and wildlife.
extraNote: $1000 deposit required for all motorboat rentals, refundable if no damage · Credit card info kept on file during rental · 48-hour cancellation policy; full fee charged if less than 48 hours notice · No alcohol or drugs permitted on vessels; right to search bags · Right to cancel reservation if clients show intoxication or disregard safety · Additional fuel charged at $3.3/L beyond included amount · March to October annually
